text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Thursday according to the official news agency APS. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Zeroual installs independent commission to watch over June 5 parliamentary elections.
- Enhanced status and extension of Algiers province will lead to better management, strengthening of local administration.
- Cabinet examines economic results for second half of 1996 which show clear evolution of balance of payments, inflation at 18.7 percent.

- Security forces blow up villa in Algiers suburb of Birkhamed which served as a bomb-making factory for Moslem guerrillas and was responsible for car bombs that exploded on Monday in Kouba. "Terrorist" network neutralised.
- 35th anniversary of Algerian people's victory against French occupation celebrated with pride throughout territory.
- Foreign Minister Attaf, on visit to Canada, holds lengthy meeting with around 100 Canadian businessmen.
- Faced with divergences among Mediterranean countries, Algeria must negotiate with European Union outside framework of Arab Maghreb Union.
